events.title: RBI hikes repo 25bp to 5.50%, stance 'calibrated tightening'
events.description: RBI MPC raised repo by 25bp to 5.50% on 7 Oct 2026 and said near-term cuts are 'off the table'; FY27 GDP forecast raised to 7.1%, FY27 CPI forecast to 5.2% (per Business Standard/Moneycontrol headlines). Sector-policy relevance: tightening cycle hits NBFC/housing finance margins and rate-sensitives.
events.what_already_moved: Headline-level only: Nifty 50 closed 24,461 on 5 Nov, +7.4% in 1m despite the hike (factor_state.md); US 10Y 4.89%. Exact bond-yield reaction not verified.

chains.explanation: Higher policy rate slows loan growth
Higher yields and mortgage rates dent housing demand, then housing-finance/developer equity
Funding-cost rise squeezes NBFC spreads

Business Standard: RBI MPC hikes repo by 25 bps to 5.5%

events.title: RBI expected-credit-loss (ECL) provisioning goes live as scheduled (FY28 start)
events.description: RBI's ECL framework replaces incurred-loss provisioning. SBI estimates Rs 19,500 crore post-tax hit (3 Nov 2026); Federal Bank flagged 1.5-2% net worth hit (Jul 2026). CS Setty (3 Nov) said RBI working group is still fine-tuning implementation and RBI will meet bank CEOs on readiness. 1 Apr 2027 start date is model knowledge/ not verified in fetched headlines; transition glide-path likely spreads the hit over years.
events.what_already_moved: No market price reaction isolated; banks' preparedness stories 3-5 Nov 2026.

entry_shocks.note: banks price in higher provisions on unsecured/MSME
reported credit cost higher (accounting, not cash)

chains.explanation: Higher provisioning lifts lending spreads and trims growth in risky segments
Day-1 net worth hit and higher run-rate credit cost hits PSU banks most, which have thinner buffers

sources.title: SBI puts ECL models in place, estimates Rs 19,500-crore post-tax impact (headline via Google News)

events.title: RBI defers or phases ECL (longer glide path / delayed start)
events.description: Alternative outcome to on-time ECL start: RBI working group is 'still fine tuning' (Setty, 3 Nov 2026) and several banks (e.g. Bank of India, 24 Oct) have not begun provisioning, so a delay or longer transition is plausible.

chains.explanation: Deferral removes day-1 capital hit; PSU banks re-rate

sources.title: RBI to meet bank CEOs to review ECL preparedness (headline)

events.title: SEBI partly reverses derivative expiry-settlement rule after closing-auction (CAS) volatility
events.description: After the Closing Auction Session launch caused expiry-day swings (Sept 2026), SEBI moved to rework derivative expiry closing price determination; Reuters (5 Oct) reported a partial reversal (30-min VWAP may return). Jefferies calls it a bigger positive for brokers than exchanges (16 Oct).

chains.explanation: Stable settlement supports derivatives volumes and exchange/broker revenue
Higher activity lifts broker revenue

events.title: SEBI tightens F&O further (weekly-expiry scrapping, higher margins/lot sizes)
events.description: Media (31 Aug 2026) discuss scrapping weekly expiries; SEBI already limited weekly expiries to one benchmark per exchange (2024-25). A further tightening step would cut retail F&O volumes. Probability is a judgement from discussion pieces, not a SEBI proposal.

chains.explanation: Lower option premium turnover cuts exchange transaction revenue
Broker revenue and active clients fall

events.title: SEBI board (24 Sep 2026): PMS overhaul, wider FPI access, advertising code, REIT/AIF reforms
events.description: Board approved PMS revamp, easier settlements, new ad code and FPI commodity-trade access (per Outlook Money, ET, Moneycontrol headlines). Incremental market-structure liberalisation; SME-IPO changes (min application Rs 1 lakh) proposed 16 Oct. Also SEBI cleared Adani group of minimum public shareholding charge via settlement (28 Sep).

chains.explanation: Market-access easing lifts activity and depository/exchange revenue

events.title: Union Budget 2027-28 cuts LTCG/STT burden on equities
events.description: FM Sitharaman opened the door to a capital-gains/STT review (13 Oct 2026); pre-budget meetings from 12 Oct. Nifty rose 1.6% on LTCG relief hopes (3 Nov). Budget date 1 Feb 2027 is conventional, not yet confirmed in fetched sources. Probability of a material cut judged ~28%; fiscal constraints and 2024 hike to 12.5% argue against.
events.what_already_moved: Hope premium: Nifty 50 +1.6% around 3 Nov 2026 (Multibagg AI headline).

chains.explanation: Lower post-tax return boosts retail/DII flows
